title: Live HMLR authority inventory, official endpoint contract and Strict12 routing gates
source_upgrades: Current HMLR July 2026 INSPIRE page enumerated into 318 authority-level GML inventory rows across 21 populated letter groups
EA DTM 1m metadata and persistent WCS 2.0.1 raw-elevation contract revalidated with explicit XML-client limitation recorded
OS Downloads API product-list, filters and single-match redirect contract revalidated
Terrain 50 EPSG:27700 plus ODN EPSG:5701 metadata and OSGM15 1 km/8 mm vertical model gate revalidated
Strict12 expanded with deterministic HMLR inventory routing, exact identity, EA WCS sample, Terrain50 and remote-seal gates

direct_client_notes: HMLR page was readable through current search index; direct browser open encountered a redirect loop.
EA WCS GetCapabilities returned application/xml, which the current browser parser does not render.
OS Downloads API endpoint contract was verified from current official OS documentation; no live JSON body was claimed.

official_checks: Current INSPIRE inventory states publication on 5 July 2026.
New files are published on the first Sunday of every month.
Inventory is organized under 21 populated initial-letter groups.
Structured census of the current page contains 318 local-authority GML entries.
Every enumerated authority row exposes a GML download action.
HMLR states a GIS is required to view the downloaded polygons.
Download is subject to Open Government Licence conditions.
Dataset is a subset for registered freehold land and property.
Polygons show indicative position and extent, not definitive legal extent.
A polygon on a local-authority boundary may appear in both files.
Each polygon has a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID.
The INSPIRE ID relates to a registered title.
Each release represents data from the previous month.
HMLR GML geometry is captured against British National Grid.
Official guidance warns reprojection may shift features by up to 15 m.
DTM represents terrain after removal of surface objects.
Official metadata states approximately 99% England coverage.
Newest best-resolution survey is used where repeats exist.
Resampled source data uses bilinear interpolation.
Composite contains surveys from 6 June 2000 to 2 April 2022.
Data is downloadable as GeoTIFF in 5 km National Grid tiles.
Values are metres referenced to Ordnance Datum Newlyn.
Input surveys state ±15 cm RMSE vertical accuracy.
WCS provides raw pixel elevation values.
Year suffix was removed for a persistent update endpoint.
Direct request returned XML content; current browser parser does not render application/xml.
API supports discovery and automated download of OpenData products.
API does not provide previous OpenData releases.
Product endpoint returns a list of downloadable files.
Downloads can be filtered by file name.
Downloads can be filtered by format.
Downloads can be filtered by subformat.
Downloads can be filtered by GB or National Grid area.
Redirect option returns HTTP 307 for exactly one match.
Terrain 50 is updated annually in July.
Grid has regular 50 m post spacing.
Supply uses 10 km by 10 km tiles.
Metadata records British National Grid EPSG:27700.
Metadata records Ordnance Datum Newlyn EPSG:5701.
OSGM15 uses a 1 km grid and nominal 8 mm rms mainland accuracy.
candidate_gate_templates: Current 318-authority HMLR GML inventory is available for deterministic source routing.
Exact official INSPIRE polygon identity remains unavailable until Batch128 runtime materialization.
EA DTM 1m WCS raw-elevation and NoData contracts are verified.
No numeric elevation may be sampled without exact polygon geometry and live runtime.
Terrain 50 horizontal and vertical metadata are ready for cross-check selection.
Promotion requires all runtime outputs and existing remote acceptance seals.
